title: Remark
body_md: The model assumes a plane-strain condition by default \cite{Zienkiewicz-book}, resulting in $F_{33}=1$, $E_{33}=0$, and $J=J_{2D}$. This restriction represents a boundary-value problem in which out-of-plane deformation is constrained; it is not appropriate when no such constraint is present. Together with the absence of independent in-plane normal deformation, it limits the representation of transverse deformation and the associated constitutive coupling in hyperelastic beams that are free to deform transversely.
